title: Inventory
subtitle: Stock counts per product. With tracking on, buyers see availability and orders deduct stock.

tracking.title: Stock tracking
tracking.onDescription: Buyers see confirmed availability and submitted orders deduct stock.
tracking.offDescription: Buyers don't see availability. Counts and history are kept.
tracking.disableDescription: Buyers stop seeing availability right away. Counts are kept. Turning tracking back on needs a full review of every product's count.
tracking.enableDescription: Review the count of every product (including archived ones) in one snapshot, then turn tracking on.

review.title: Review counts to turn on tracking
review.description: Enter the count you have available now for each product (excluding stock already promised). Confirm each page; when every product is confirmed, turn tracking on.
review.confirmPage: {count, plural, one {Confirm this product} other {Confirm these {count} products}}
review.incomplete: Confirm every product before turning tracking on.
review.stale: Your catalogue or stock changed since this review was prepared. Start a new review.
review.countInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.

stock.title: Stock
stock.countInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
stock.deltaInvalid: Enter a whole change other than 0, e.g. 24 or -3.
stock.uncertain: We couldn't confirm whether this change was saved. Retrying sends the same change, which is never applied twice.
stock.trackingOffNote: Tracking is off: counts are kept but buyers don't see them.
stock.trackingOnHint: With tracking on, active products need a confirmed count.
